engine: infer/vc/pipeline.py (offline pipeline, used today by rvc_service/engine.py)
method: torch.cuda.synchronize() around vc.pipeline.pipeline(), 1 warm-up + 6 timed calls per config, same loaded model reused across configs
reading: Per-call cost has a large fixed component (~350ms floor) that does not shrink much with window size, because the offline pipeline recomputes F0 and fully decodes the whole window every call. RTF crosses 1.0 (no longer real-time) once hop drops below roughly 0.5-0.8s on this GPU -- shrinking hop/context alone on this code path cannot reach sub-second latency without breaking real-time.
